name: Misa no Mahou Monogatari
source:
Misa no Mahomonogatari - Heartful Memories tells the story of a man named Phirim who was given a mission by the Queen of a magical world to travel to the human world, find a young girl and train her into a tarot magician so that she could defeat the evil forces willing to conquer both of worlds.

The game takes place in high school and will last 4 years of training, the main character of the game is Misa and during that time period she has to train her abilities, meet different people and classmates, and face the evil that endangers the world.

[From [url=https://psxdatacenter.com/games/J/M/SLPS-01276.html]psxdatacenter[/url]]
translation:
《Misa no Mahomonogatari：Heartful Memories》讲述了一个名叫菲利姆的男人。他受魔法世界女王的委托前往人类世界，寻找一名小女孩，将她培养成塔罗牌魔法师，以打败企图征服两个世界的邪恶势力。

游戏发生在高中，训练将持续4年。游戏的主角是美沙，在这段时间里，她必须训练自己的能力，结识不同的人和同学，并面对危及世界的邪恶。

[来自 [url=https://psxdatacenter.com/games/J/M/SLPS-01276.html]psxdatacenter[/url]]
